$label: Control Room · the operator instrument, dark + light
$description: The theme the Control Room dashboard app ships. One brand definition emitting BOTH schemes via `$modes`, so dark and light are the same theme rather than two separately-authored palettes. It inherits the built-in `dark` signal ramp UNCHANGED — the state ramp is the instrument's readout and is not a branding surface (Law 2) — and declares only the surface ramp and the per-scheme ink. The light mode turns on `$fitSignals` so the inherited signals stay legible on near-white surfaces. Build → dist/themes/control-room.css (dark) + dist/themes/control-room-light.css.
